## T05.1. Pure sync, rename, and Missing decisions

**Requirements:** MW-R27, MW-R30.  
**Acceptance:** A32, A36.

### Exact task files

- `crates/vestrace-domain/src/source/sync.rs`
- `crates/vestrace-application/src/source/sync.rs`
- `crates/vestrace-domain/tests/source_sync.rs`
- `crates/vestrace-application/src/source/import_handler.rs`

### Interfaces, implementation, and required observations

**Interface:** Trusted internal SyncFacts compares immutable B/I/M payloads, identities, and
override state; it cannot be deserialized from HTTP. classify_sync returns the closed decisions
Unchanged/Rename/Update/Conflict/Missing/Blocked. Read materials under authorization, compute
equality outside SQL, then recheck exact versions under locks. No public digest oracle.

Identical identity/content with no relevant change is Unchanged. Locator-only change with
established identity is Rename, not a content revision. I != B without an edit allows Update;
manual override or changed M requires Conflict. Partial scans cannot assert Missing; complete
scans may record it, not deletion. Changed labels are Blocked. Existing open conflicts produce
conflict_pending, not an overwrite. Enumerate decisions and reject client comparison flags.

A32/A36 verify no extra canonical revision for unchanged/rename and no purge from Missing.

### Verification command

Run only after the target/fixture exists. Verify behavioral RED, then GREEN and every linked case under the [shared procedure](README.md#shared-task-procedure). These are not results of this documentation edition.

```bash
cargo test -p vestrace-domain --test source_sync --locked
```


## T05.2. B/I/M conflicts and explicit resolution

**Requirements:** MW-R28, MW-R29.  
**Acceptance:** A33, A34, A35.

### Exact task files

- `migrations/0198_source_sync_conflicts.sql`
- `crates/vestrace-application/src/source/sync.rs`
- `crates/vestrace-http/src/api/source_conflicts.rs`
- `apps/console/src/routes/SourceConflictPage.tsx`
- `crates/vestrace-infrastructure/tests/source_sync_races.rs`
- `crates/vestrace-application/src/memory/write.rs`
- `crates/vestrace-infrastructure/src/postgres/memory_mutation_repository.rs`

### Interfaces, implementation, and required observations

**Interface:** SourceSyncService::resolve(ctx,conflict_id,ResolveConflictRequest,key) returns
MutationReceipt. Only accept_source/keep_manual/merge are accepted with common idempotency
and exact conflict/memory/incoming-source preconditions. One source has one open conflict.
ConflictDetail exposes immutable original_manual_revision=M0 and permitted current
manual_revision=M separately; current need not equal detection-time M0.

Take approved collection/source/conflict/memory guards and reauthorize every basis. Check
current pointer/state and immutable conflict refs without silent rebase. accept_source creates
I and clears override; keep_manual preserves M and its revision with a recorded override;
merge creates explicit user text with override. Atomically record resolution Event, binding,
version, audit, and receipt before closing the conflict. Source bytes never change.

Show M0→M, retain drafts after stale rejection, and refresh bases. Ordinary correction updates
manual_override in the shared MW-02 writer files; include both in exact scope before editing.
A35 must first reject stale resolution, then succeed after fresh detail while preserving M0
and the intervening edit. No model-driven merging.

### Verification command

Run only after the target/fixture exists. Verify behavioral RED, then GREEN and every linked case under the [shared procedure](README.md#shared-task-procedure). These are not results of this documentation edition.

```bash
cargo test -p vestrace-infrastructure --test source_sync_races --locked -- --test-threads=1
npm --prefix apps/console run test:e2e:memory
```


## T05.3. Both cancel/apply outcomes and collection serialization

**Requirements:** MW-R31, MW-R32.  
**Acceptance:** A37, A38, A39.

### Exact task files

- `crates/vestrace-application/src/source/import.rs`
- `crates/vestrace-application/src/source/import_handler.rs`
- `crates/vestrace-infrastructure/src/postgres/source_repository.rs`
- `crates/vestrace-infrastructure/tests/source_sync_races.rs`

### Interfaces, implementation, and required observations

**Interface:** cancel(ctx,operation_id,CancelRequest,key) returns ImportOperation.
collection.active_import_id serializes batch admission, not ordinary editing. Item/completion
locks fence post-cancel writes. Cleanup consumes existing retention/material authorities,
not an independent scheduler.

Reject a second active Apply while permitting individual edits. Before item commit, recheck
bases and cancellation under consistent lock order. A committed-first item stays committed;
cancellation skips the rest. A winning cancel prevents later mutation. Expiry applies to
staging/preview_ready; accepted Apply owns its material until lawful retirement. Clear the
active import only after a durable terminal outcome. Replay cancel from its receipt; elapsed
time does not prove a writer dead.

A37–A39 exercise both winners with bounded race/crash fixtures. No fictional rollback or
erasure of already applied material is acceptable.

### Verification command

Run only after the target/fixture exists. Verify behavioral RED, then GREEN and every linked case under the [shared procedure](README.md#shared-task-procedure). These are not results of this documentation edition.

```bash
cargo test -p vestrace-infrastructure --test source_sync_races --locked -- --test-threads=1
```
